'''Avery Poliak''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Las Vegas tournament (17 March)]] on 17 March 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|COTVG]], according to Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1915">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-las-vegas-3-17-and-3-18d1915/ las-vegas-3-17-and-3-18], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-las-vegas-3-17-and-3-18d1915/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
